items.d: Across military and commercial aircraft environments—from Royal Air Force airframe technician to founder and operator.
EASA Part-66 Aircraft Maintenance Engineer Licence No. 101488 · FAA Airframe & Powerplant Licence No. 257104.
Aircraft Engineering, Kingston University London. Cardiff University Bond Solon Expert Witness Civil Certificate, 2024.
Instructed by both sides, and available as single joint expert. Written reports for aviation matters worldwide.
